summary: Diff focuses on frontend UI/content updates and an expanded publishing checklist, but does not show concrete fixes to the deployment failure (backend/config/build pipeline) and the publishing guide still lacks required troubleshooting guidance for bindings and deploy failures. Additionally, multiple new/expanded site sections/features appear to be introduced despite non-goals.

missing_requirements.requirement: Investigate the reported deployment failure and implement the minimal code/config changes needed so the project builds and deploys successfully to the Internet Computer using the documented commands (dfx generate backend, pnpm build:skip-bindings, dfx deploy).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows only frontend component/content changes and documentation edits; no backend (`backend/main.mo`) or deployment/build configuration changes are evidenced that would directly address a `dfx generate backend` / build / `dfx deploy` failure.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add/adjust developer-facing deployment troubleshooting notes in frontend/PUBLISHING.md including: (1) how to identify missing static assets, (2) what to do if dfx generate backend outputs outdated bindings, and (3) what to check when dfx deploy fails. Use English text only.
missing_requirements.reason: `frontend/PUBLISHING.md` adds an asset checklist (covers missing static assets), but it does not include guidance on outdated generated bindings from `dfx generate backend`, nor does it include a troubleshooting section for diagnosing `dfx deploy` failures.
